name: beautifulrepo
description: Audit repository onboarding, preview gated README improvements, or draft unpublished release notes from local evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Audit onboarding, plan README fixes or draft Git release notes.
interface.longDescription: Audit README, links and onboarding with local read-only tools, preview a scoped README diff with explicit approval before edits, or draft unpublished release notes from local Git history. Standalone tools do not make network requests; agent sessions may send repository context to the configured model provider. No workflow publishes changes, and unverified output or badges are not asserted.
